violations.why: closer2_isr (priority 2) can preempt main between its two reads of test_global_var1 and change the value.
writer2_isr can preempt main between the two reads of test_global_var2 and write it. Its condition is satisfied once writer1_isr has run.

closer2_isr, running inside i8xx_tco_write, clears the flag to 0 between closer1_isr's write of 42 and its read.
